catalysts.description: The company lists 2026 only; manifests show Q1 2027 / TBD. Not treated as a dated catalyst.

risks: IM-3's landing date is genuinely unconfirmed this cycle — sources conflict between an H2 2026 landing attempt and a Q1 2027 launch entirely; treat any specific date as low-confidence until the company clarifies
IM-1 and IM-2 both toppled onto their side shortly after touching down — a clean IM-3 landing is not assured even once the date is confirmed
ATM equity issuance keeps share count in flux — a hawkish Fed (rates just hiked to 3.75-4.00%) raises the cost of that ongoing dilution
Analyst targets show real dispersion this cycle (Strong Buy consensus $29.50 vs a separately reported 'edged down to $14.38' figure) — treat the headline upside with some caution
Stock is down -11.8% since the last report despite no negative company-specific news identified — could reflect broader space-sector rotation

analystTargets.note: One source shows targets 'edged slightly lower' on delayed-launch concerns — flags real dispersion, not used as the primary consensus

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Space-infrastructure names are volatile on both launch-cadence news and financing headlines; a hawkish Fed compounds the latter.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.
